thread:
ravi: quick FYI — onboarding hit: new hire set REDWOOD_API_KEY in their .env for the sample app, but our workspaces expect a project-scoped token. CI used org key and failed with permission denied.

mei: ugh. do we still have both env names in samples?

ravi: yeah, README still says REDWOOD_API_KEY for simplicity. the SDK now prefers REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN but we don't warn by default, so it silently picked the wrong scope.

claire: that's bad. small ask: add a one-line startup warning when multiple REDWOOD_* tokens are present or when legacy var is used and we detect project-scoped resources are requested. Keep it non-noisy though.

sam: agreed. also add `rw whoami --env` to the CLI to show which env var was used (name only, not value). super quick for debugging CI.

mei: we should also add a tiny shim in our official sample apps: docker entrypoint checks envs and if only REDWOOD_API_KEY exists, set REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN from it and log a redacted warning with migration steps. opt-in via SAMPLE_MIGRATE_LEGACY=true.

ravi: that sounds safe. for k8s, infra: can we map legacy secret keys during helm deploy? e.g. patch secret to include both `redwood.project_token` and `redwood.api_key` keys for a short window.

infra: yep we can add a helm post-install hook and a migration script. we'll coordinate a 2-week overlap window. we'll also add docs on safely rotating secrets in-cluster.

claire: SDK change: make precedence explicit and testable: 1) REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN, 2) REDWOOD_CLI_EPHEMERAL, 3) REDWOOD_API_KEY (legacy). Emit a single telemetry event when legacy used so we can measure impact.

mei: add tests in node/python/go asserting precedence and a docker-compose e2e that simulates host env vs .env collisions. catch regressions.

sam: and add rotation guidance in sample readmes: k8s pattern (write both keys, rollout, remove legacy), GH Actions pattern (use per-run ephemeral tokens or store project token), docker-compose snippet for local workstations.

ravi: i've filed DEVX-8475 with repro steps and a minimal docker-compose and GH Actions example. linking doc draft in docs/onboarding/migrate-keys.md (WIP).

devx-bot: Reminder: open RFC for "env var canonicalization and migration plan" and attach test matrix and sample app checklist.

infra: noted. we'll standardize on `redwood.project_token` in charts and add a compatibility map in the Helm values doc.

claire: one more DX thought — surface token TTL early. if token TTL < 5m emit a WARN so CI can fail fast. add a helper `redwood.auth.ttl()` in SDKs.

mei: will PR sample app shim + docs. will gate behind FEATURE_ENV_MIGRATE flag and flip after samples updated.

ravi: thanks everyone. small steps but will save a lot of confused new devs. posting RFC link when ready. :rocket:
